project.presalesUseCase: Secure Kubernetes platform for clinical systems (EHR and PACS), with LGPD compliance
project.businessIssue: LGPD audit found missing isolation and access-control evidence for patient data; clusters have no central management
project.targetInfrastructure: 2 on-prem RKE2 clusters (production and staging), 6 nodes of 16 vCPU/64 GB each, VMware as hypervisor

tests.title: Rancher is up: rollout and login page
tests.expected: The deploy/rancher rollout completes and the login page answers over HTTPS on the hospital hostname

tests.title: First login and admin password
tests.expected: Login with the bootstrap password; admin password and Server URL set

tests.title: Import the existing production cluster (RKE2)
tests.expected: The cluster goes from Pending to Active and the Default and System projects appear

tests.title: Sign in with the hospital's Active Directory
tests.expected: An AD user authenticates to Rancher and is mapped to a group

tests.title: RBAC: Clinical-IT, Infrastructure and Audit roles
tests.expected: Three users with different roles see and do only what their role allows

tests.title: Rancher backup to an S3 bucket
tests.expected: The scheduled backup completes and is visible in the bucket

tests.title: Rancher restore on a clean install
tests.expected: Clusters, users and settings are recovered on the same version

tests.title: Namespace isolation for clinical systems (EHR and PACS)
tests.expected: Separate projects with Resource Quota and Network Policy; traffic between them blocked by default

tests.title: Publish the scheduling app via Fleet (GitOps)
tests.expected: A change in the Git repository is applied to both clusters within 2 minutes; rollback by reverting the commit

tests.title: Install SUSE Security and discover the EHR traffic
tests.expected: The connection graph shows the EHR pods and their real flows (Discover mode)

tests.title: Monitor → Protect mode: block an unexpected connection
tests.expected: An ad hoc connection from a test pod to the EHR database is blocked and raises a violation

tests.title: Vulnerability scan of images and nodes
tests.expected: CVE report per image/node, filterable by severity, with CSV export

tests.title: Admission control: block images with critical CVEs or from unapproved registries
tests.expected: Deploying an image with a critical CVE is denied with a clear message; a clean image is admitted

tests.title: DLP: detect CPF/CNS numbers in unauthorized traffic (LGPD)
tests.expected: An alert fires when a CPF pattern flows from a pod to a disallowed external destination

tests.title: Compliance report (CIS Kubernetes) for the audit
tests.expected: CIS report generated with failed items and suggested remediation; evidence for the privacy team

tests.title: Forward security events to the SIEM via syslog/webhook
tests.expected: A violation raised in the test shows up in the hospital SIEM within 1 minute
